Method of Attack: Bulk smishing attacks exploiting Amazon Web Services (AWS) Simple Notification Service (SNS)
Attack Vector: Lure recipients into clicking on malicious links embedded in the messages, leading to the compromise of personally identifiable information (PII) and payment card details
Indicators of Compromise: A list of phishing links, AWS access keys, target phone numbers, message content, and sender IDs

Method of Attack: Propagation of various information stealers and remote access trojans (RATs) targeting Windows users
Attack Vector: Deployment through a four-stage infection chain that starts with an ISO file embedded within email messages
